guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - East Gloucestershire
guard_streams.write_limit: Awarded contract scope and anticipated dates are procurement evidence and cannot verify current selected-parcel serviceability.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 22 February 2024.
Gigaclear is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 4,400 premises.
The contract value is £16 million.
The contract was signed in February 2024.
Gloucestershire County Council is listed as collaborating on delivery.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access in 2024.
A service can be requested after the network has been built.
The premises list is subject to detailed planning and technical change.
Further premises detail is published through BDUK transparency data.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes
guard_streams.write_limit: Original and redesigned contract figures are procurement scope; detailed planning, commercial overlap and technical change prevent current parcel promotion.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 6 February 2024.
The page was last updated on 26 May 2026.
The original contract covered around 25,000 premises.
The original contract value was £51 million.
The original contract was signed in February 2024.
CityFibre and BDUK redesigned the contract in May 2026.
The redesigned contract covers around 6,000 premises.
The redesigned investment is £19.8 million.
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with commercial rollout.
The premises list remains subject to detailed planning and technical change.
